simple.summary: חֲזוֹת (chăzôwth) means a view First listed occurrence: Dan 4 8.

definitions.full: H2379. chazoth [ חֲזוֺת K § 55, 6 b) 2 ; read perhaps וּת +? § 61, 4 b), Anm. ] noun feminine sight, visibility (see Schulth ZAW xxii (1902). 165 f. ); — suffix חֲווֺהֵתּ Dan 4:8 , 17 .
